content: Root cause: The root cause of the bug was an undeclared identifier 'm_state_enum' when compiling with the MinGW compiler. This occurred because the explicit cast to 'm_state_enum' was included in the code after a previous change (commit 0a482f255) which likely assumed the code would only be compiled with MSVC, where 'm_state_enum' was previously defined or recognized. The fix involved conditionally including the cast only for MSVC, while allowing the code to compile without it for MinGW, which does not require the explicit cast.

Root cause:
The root cause of the bug was an undeclared identifier 'm_state_enum' when compiling with the MinGW compiler. This occurred because the explicit cast to 'm_state_enum' was included in the code after a previous change (commit 0a482f255) which likely assumed the code would only be compiled with MSVC, where 'm_state_enum' was previously defined or recognized. The fix involved conditionally including the cast only for MSVC, while allowing the code to compile without it for MinGW, which does not require the explicit cast.
Patch:
From a6bd55ddf6f373e2b0433bec8783b231002346d6 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Garrett Brown <garbearucla@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Apr 2013 06:10:12 -0700
Subject: [PATCH] Fixed mingw compile error introduced in 0a482f255:
 'm_state_enum' undeclared identifier, explicit cast isn't necessary so only
 include it when MSVC C++ fix is needed

---
 NQ/menu.c | 8 ++++++++
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+)

diff --git a/NQ/menu.c b/NQ/menu.c
index a690cd9..91eabf1 100644
--- a/NQ/menu.c
+++ b/NQ/menu.c
@@ -1555,7 +1555,11 @@ M_Quit_Key(int key)
     case 'n':
     case 'N':
 	if (wasInMenus) {
+#ifdef _MSC_VER
 	    m_state = (m_state_enum)m_quit_prevstate;
+#else
+	    m_state = m_quit_prevstate;
+#endif
 	    m_entersound = true;
 	} else {
 	    key_dest = key_game;
@@ -1584,7 +1588,11 @@ static void
 M_Quit_Draw(void)
 {
     if (wasInMenus) {
+#ifdef _MSC_VER
 	m_state = (m_state_enum)m_quit_prevstate;
+#else
+	m_state = m_quit_prevstate;
+#endif
 	m_recursiveDraw = true;
 	M_Draw();
 	m_state = m_quit;
--
